items.title: $2.5 Billion In Payouts, A Lagging Stock: The CLF Trade-Off
items.summary: This steelmaker sent a fortune back to its owners, but the stock went nowhere. Here’s the paradox of the payout, and what it means now.

items.title: U.S. Steel Stocks Nucor, Steel Dynamics Give Up Initial Gains On Canada Trade Talks Collapse
items.summary: Canada trade talks failed, leaving 50% steel and aluminum tariffs in place. But U.S. steel stocks Nucor and Steel Dynamics slashed big gains.

items.title: Marvell, Micron, SpaceX, XPeng, Tesla, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks were mostly lower on Monday with the major indexes weighed down by falling artificial-intelligence stocks ahead of Nvidia’s  key earnings and Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole comments later this week.

items.title: Fresh Tariffs Boost Domestic Steel, Dent Automakers
items.summary: Trade talks between the U.S. and Canada collapsed in the 11th hour Friday, renewing fears of an all-out trade war as new tariffs went into effect over the weekend. Ford and Stellantis shares slipped Monday after President Trump announced a 50% tariff on automobiles and auto parts from Canada come January.

items.title: U.S. and Canada Escalate Their Trade Fight. It Won’t Be the Last Tariff Tiff.
items.summary: Another trade war has started with a volley of tariff threats, and this time the fight is with America’s neighbor and closest trading partner, Canada.  While the U.S. has held several formal negotiations with Mexico this year about the USMCA, it hasn’t done so with Canada.

items.title: STLD Stock Leads U.S. Steel Stocks Higher Amid Escalating Trade War With Canada
items.summary: Steel Dynamics shares rally as President Trump threatens 50% tariffs on Canadian steel. But does that warrant buying STLD stock at current levels?

items.title: Stellantis Gets Squeezed at the Border
items.summary: Trump’s Canada tariff threat hit Detroit broadly, but Stellantis has the most awkward plant problem sitting right in the middle of it.

items.title: Steel Stocks Jump as U.S.-Canada Tariff Fight Escalates
items.summary: Steel Dynamics, Nucor, and Cleveland-Cliffs shares rise as escalating U.S.-Canada trade tensions put steel tariffs back in focus.
